setup: Every case starts from its own empty data folder (LITTLEBUDDY_DATA_DIR = a new temp dir, absent profile.json = memory on, A40/REQ-036), real Bonsai, Wi-Fi off. 'say' = the lines are sent in one chat as the page sends them (POST /api/respond {line, history}, history = the earlier lines and replies of that chat). 'wait' = 30 s after the last reply, no line sent in that time (chat quiet, A32; 01 §1). 'restart' = stop the server, npm start again, new chat (history []). Base: say FX-014-01 lines, wait (关于你 holds 面试), set the profile name to 团子; stop; copy the three files aside.

cases.break: truncate profile.json to floor(byte length / 2) bytes (no longer valid JSON)

steps: start, open the page, read the page and GET /api/profile, GET /api/diary

不过今天模拟面试表现得还不错，好开心！
